units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 100b:8">Snh. 100ᵇ</cite> (from Ben Sira) <he>אמר במאי איכול ל׳ ל׳ סב מיניה</he> if a man says, ‘wherewith shall I eat bread (to season it)?’, take the bread from him.
